newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB grain and soybean values were unchanged on Monday in very quiet dealings as the market prepared for Wednesday's Christmas holiday, export sources said.
"Nobody is going to buy anything this week," one source said. "The market really shuts down until next year."
In export news, Pakistan bought 180,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and 90,000 tonnes of Australian wheat over the weekend, several U.S. exporters said. Delivery dates were January 8 to 31.
